name: a100_lite_m16
description: The a100_lite SM at 16 SMs, the memory system scaled to 16/108 of the A100's (a100_lite's rule).

sources.inherited (a100_lite): the SM, and the rule that scales the memory system with the SMs
sources.L2_SIZE 4 MiB: nearest power of two to 0.3 MiB x 16 = 4.8 MiB
